# Sites de contenu

- NIST (National Institute of Standards and Technologie) - Webbook de chimie. Regroupe des propriétés thermophysiques, très pratique pour tracer des diagrammes thermodynamiques.

```         
import requests
import numpy as np

Temp = [-33, -20? -10, 0, 20, 30,] #np.arange( -50, 150, 10)

for T in Temp:
    print( T )
    url = f'https://webbook.nist.gov/cgi/fluid.cgi?Action=Data&Wide=on&ID=C7664417&Type=IsoTherm&Digits=5&PLow=0.1&PHigh=200&PInc=0.1&T={T}&RefState=DEF&TUnit=C&PUnit=bar&DUnit=kg%2Fm3&HUnit=kJ%2Fkg&WUnit=m%2Fs&VisUnit=uPa*s&STUnit=N%2Fm'
    r = requests.get(url, allow_redirects=True)
    open( f'isotherme_T={T}.txt', 'wb').write(r.content)
```
